in_marathi.name: Mayuransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayuransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayuransh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mayura' which means peacock. In Hindu mythology, the peacock is considered the vehicle of Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya, the God of War. The name Mayuransh signifies the power, strength, and grace associated with the peacock and the deity it represents.
